notes: litert-community/Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B: nemotron3_nano_30b_a3b_mixed_int4_ekv2048.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16 at revision bf77c317 (NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License), a 52-layer hybrid decoder (23 Mamba-2 layers, 23 mixture-of-experts layers with 128 routed experts of which 6 are used for each token plus one shared expert, 6 attention layers; 30B parameters, 3.5B active) that thinks before it answers by default; written with the LiteRT Tensor API one tensor at a time: each layer's routed experts in one `moe` custom op, relu² written as the op's gelu_tanh with the input scaled by 256 and each expert's output by 1/65,536, and an exact `moe * 0` second consumer so the GPU delegate does not fuse the next op into the expert kernel; routed experts int4 blockwise (block 32, fp32 scales raised to at least 2^-14; ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.1's min-max rules) in the moe op; token table, Mamba-2 in / out projections, attention q / k / v / o, shared experts and lm_head int8 per channel; router, norms and the Mamba-2 convolution, A, D and dt bias fp32; fp32 activations declared; KV cache 2,048 (the mixed_int4 ekv4096 file of this repository with the cache length 2,048: 419 bytes differ); the checkpoint's tokenizer.json byte for byte. The repository holds four files (int4 and mixed_int4, each with a 2,048- and a 4,096-token cache); each has its own model id. Mac Studio rows only; no phone was tried. This document holds the file's benchmark cells of 2026-11-12; its line-3 records are in the 2026-11-10 document of the same model id. Landed 2026-11-12 after the close-out: litert-community/Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B is public and ungated (license other: nvidia-nemotron-open-model-license; base_model nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16, quantized; library_name litert-lm), main 5792549c3a (2026-11-12T12:56:32.000Z) at the read; these bytes reached the Hub at commit ac7bc38aba (2026-11-10T12:28:00.000Z); the tree's LFS oid and size of nemotron3_nano_30b_a3b_mixed_int4_ekv2048.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 20625860800 B (anonymous, read 2026-11-12 22:45:54 JST).
